newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso steady, firm on mild dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso steady, firm on mild dollar inflows.

text.p: Mexican peso contracts retained initial strength at mid-morning trade on Tuesday amid moderate capital flow to the local bourse and money market, dealers said.
"We have a trickle of dollars into the market from foreign investors," dealers said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart stood 1.85 and 1.8 centavos firmer, respectively, at 7.7550/7.7575 and 7.7530/7.7550 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile ended trade 2.1 centavos firmer at 7.7500/7.7530 per dollar.
Dealers said the market was calm and hopeful the Federal Open Market Committee would not raise U.S. interest rates later in the day.
